schema.title: Minecraft Resource Pack Particle

description:
Dear team,

For the upcoming resource‑pack update, I've compiled the list of particle textures that will be included. These assets are located in the standard Minecraft directory structure and will replace the default visuals for the corresponding effects.

- assets/minecraft/textures/particle/smoke.png  
- assets/minecraft/textures/particle/flame.png  
- assets/minecraft/textures/particle/sparkle.png  

Please ensure these files are packaged correctly before the next build.
